def solve(v):
    return sum(v) // len(v)

def main():
    import sys
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    v = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    print(solve(v))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
